criteria: Zero frontend types with inner { success, data } double-envelope
novelQualityCheck returns decision field from backend
All story-bible POST endpoints strip workspace before entity merge
Frontend listSkills type matches backend { skills: [] } wrapper

tasks.title: RC-1: Remove double-envelope from knowledge.ts + analysis.ts
tasks.description: Fix 5 knowledge.ts functions (plantForeshadow, getForeshadowStats, analyzeCharacterDepth, getCharacterProfile, getCharacterRelationships) and 2 analysis.ts functions (detectPatterns, clusterSessions) that incorrectly wrap response type with inner { success, data: T } envelope. Change ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: T }> to ApiResponse<T> where T is the raw backend body shape.
changes: plantForeshadow: ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: ForeshadowItem }> → ApiResponse<ForeshadowItem>
getForeshadowStats: ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: ForeshadowStats }> → ApiResponse<ForeshadowStats>
analyzeCharacterDepth: ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: CharacterDepthAssessment }> → ApiResponse<CharacterDepthAssessment>
getCharacterProfile: ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: CharacterProfile }> → ApiResponse<CharacterProfile>
getCharacterRelationships: ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: CharacterRelationshipNetwork }> → ApiResponse<CharacterRelationshipNetwork>
detectPatterns: ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: DetectedPattern[] }> → ApiResponse<DetectedPattern[]>
clusterSessions: ApiResponse<{ success: boolean; data: SessionCluster[] }> → ApiResponse<SessionCluster[]>

tasks.title: RC-2: Add decision field to novelQualityCheck backend response
tasks.description: Add score→decision mapping to novelQualityCheckEndpoint. Derive decision from total_score: >=80 APPROVED, >=60 REVISE, >=40 REWRITE, else HUMAN_REVIEW. Include in jsonResponse.
changes: Add decision derivation logic after evaluateNovelQuality call
Add decision field to success response and qualityDefaultPayload

tasks.title: RC-7: Strip workspace from story-bible entity body before merge
tasks.description: Add 'delete body.workspace' in sbCreateEntityEndpoint and sbUpdateEntityEndpoint alongside existing 'delete body.id' etc. Prevents workspace context data from leaking into entity storage.
changes: sbCreateEntityEndpoint: add 'delete body.workspace' after delete body.id/novelId/type/createdAt
sbUpdateEntityEndpoint: add 'delete body.workspace' after delete body.id/novelId/type/createdAt
tasks.verification: npx vitest run src-ts/ --reporter=verbose (relevant story-bible tests)

tasks.title: RC-3/4/5/6: Fix m10/skills/plugins frontend types
tasks.description: Fix 4 frontend type mismatches: getStyleProfile nullable, listSkills wrapper, PluginResult shape, registerPlugin response shape.
changes: getStyleProfile: ApiResponse<Record<string, unknown>> → ApiResponse<Record<string, unknown> | null>
listSkills: ApiResponse<Array<{ id: string; name: string }>> → ApiResponse<{ skills: Array<{ id: string; name: string }> }>
PluginResult: redefine as { pluginId: string; pluginName: string; score: number; maxScore: number; evidence: string; suggestions: string[]; details: Record<string, unknown> }
registerPlugin: ApiResponse<{ id: string; status: string }> → ApiResponse<{ id: string; name: string }>
PluginInfo: remove 'enabled: boolean' or make optional

tasks.title: RC-8: Add workspace scope to foreshadowStatsEndpoint
tasks.description: Change foreshadowStatsEndpoint to accept request, read workspace from body/headers, and pass scope to graphGetForeshadows calls for workspace-scoped statistics.
changes: Change signature: (_request: HttpRequest) → (request: HttpRequest)
Add resolveGraphScope(parseBody(request)) call
Pass scope to all 3 graphGetForeshadows calls

tasks.title: RC-2b: Fix novelQualityCheck error swallowing
tasks.description: Change novelQualityCheckEndpoint error handling: instead of returning qualityDefaultPayload() with 200 on exception, return jsonResponse({ error: message }, 500) to properly signal failure.
changes: Replace qualityDefaultPayload() fallback in catch block with jsonResponse({ error: 'Quality evaluation failed' }, 500)

tasks.title: W-004: Fix getForeshadows status default semantic mismatch
tasks.description: When frontend doesn't specify status, backend defaults to 'pending' instead of returning all statuses. Fix backend to use undefined/no-filter when status is not provided.
changes: Change graphForeshadowsEndpoint: default body.status to undefined (no filter) instead of 'pending'

tasks.title: W-020: Add consumer-side null guard for getStyleProfile
tasks.description: In frontend consumers of getStyleProfile, add null guard since backend returns null when unimplemented. This is a defensive measure alongside the type fix in TASK-004.
changes: Add null check: if result.data === null, handle gracefully (show 'no profile' state)
tasks.verification: TypeScript compiles, existing styleProfile tests pass
